message.content:
Implement all approved UX improvements to the Dashboard page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app._index.tsx`.

Read the ENTIRE file first before making ANY changes.

---

## All Changes to Implement

### 1. Page-level
- `subtitle` → `subtitle={\`${planLabel} Plan\`` }` (shows plan in page subtitle, e.g. "Free Plan")
- Remove plan badge from stats card header entirely (it moves to subtitle)
- New section order (top to bottom):
  1. App Status card (always)
  2. Stats card (only when `!isEmpty`)
  3. Usage bar (only when `isFreePlan && !isEmpty && limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity`)
  4. Upgrade banner (only when `isFreePlan && !isEmpty && usagePercent >= 60`)
  5. Getting Started card (only when `isEmpty`)
  6. Quick Actions (always)

### 2. App Status card
- Rename title: "Storefront Status" → "App Status"
- Refresh button: change `variant="plain"` → `variant="tertiary"` and add `size="slim"`
- **Active state**: Remove "Manage App Embeds" and "Edit Widget in Theme" buttons. Replace with a single `Button` with `variant="plain"` and `icon={ExternalIcon}` that says "Open Theme Editor" linking to `themeEditorUrl` with `target="_blank"`
- **Not active state**: Remove the `InlineGrid` with the two nested `Box` step cards. Replace with a simple `BlockStack gap="300"` containing two plain rows. Each row: `InlineStack gap="300" blockAlign="center"` with a small circle number + `BlockStack` with bold label + subdued description + inline link button. No background boxes, no nested padding. Keep the warning Banner above.

Row format:
```
1  Enable App Embed        In Theme Editor → App Embeds → toggle on Zip Code Checker    [Open ↗]
2  Add Widget to Pages     Product template → Add block → Zip Code Checker → Save       [Open ↗]
```
Use `Button variant="plain" icon={ExternalIcon}` for each link. No `Box` wrappers.

### 3. Upgrade banner
- Move to AFTER stats card (section order already handled above)
- Condition: `isFreePlan && !isEmpty && usagePercent >= 60` (was: `isFreePlan` always)
- Shorten body text to: `You've used {stats.total} of {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited zip codes, blocked zones, and delivery rules.`
- Remove `secondaryAction` — keep only `action={{ content: "Upgrade to Pro", onAction: ... }}`

### 4. Getting Started card
- Change the step container from `InlineStack gap="600" blockAlign="start" wrap` → `InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 3 }} gap="400"`
- Step number circles: change `background="bg-surface-secondary"` → `background="bg-fill-brand"` and add `tone="text-inverse"` on the number `Text`
- Hide when `!isEmpty` (already conditional, no change needed to condition)

### 5. Stats Overview card
- Remove card title "Overview" and its `Divider` — just show the `InlineGrid` of metrics directly inside the `Card` with `padding` from the Card itself
- Remove plan badge from stats header (moved to page subtitle)
- **Blocked zones metric**: Remove the inline "Pro+" `Badge`. Replace with a `Tooltip` wrapping the label text: `<Tooltip content="Available on Pro plan"><Text>Blocked zones 🔒</Text></Tooltip>`. Import `Tooltip` from `@shopify/polaris`.
- **Waitlist metric**: Change label from "Waitlist entries" → "On waitlist". Move the "New" badge: instead of inline with the number, add a second `Text` line below the label: `{stats.waitlist > 0 && <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="caution">{stats.waitlist} waiting</Text>}` — actually keep the existing badge but put it BELOW the number not inline. Use `BlockStack gap="050"` and put `Badge` on its own line below the number.
- **Delivery Rules**: Add as 5th metric in the grid. Change `InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 2, sm: 4 }}` → `columns={{ xs: 2, sm: 3, md: 5 }}`. Add: number = `stats.deliveryRules`, label = "Delivery rules", tone = default.
- Remove the "View →" `Button` link that sits inside the stats card next to the waitlist metric — it's inside a metric block which is non-standard. Remove this inline navigation button.

### 6. Plan Usage bar
- Remove from inside the stats card entirely
- Create a new `Layout.Section` AFTER the stats card (before upgrade banner):
  - Condition: `isFreePlan && !isEmpty && limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity`
  - Use a slim `Banner tone={usagePercent >= 80 ? "warning" : "info"}` (not a Card) with no title
  - Content: `{stats.total} of {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes used` + inline `ProgressBar`
  - Remove the "Upgrade now" button from here (upgrade banner handles it)
  - Use `Banner` with `tone` and put the ProgressBar inside the Banner body

### 7. Quick Actions section
- **Zip Codes card**: Make it full-width (separate `Layout.Section` above the 2x2 grid). Add `background="bg-surface-highlight"` on a `Box` wrapper inside the Card to visually differentiate it. Add small stat: `{stats.total} zip codes · {stats.allowed} allowed` as a subdued text line. Remove the `Button` inside. Make the `Card` itself trigger navigation via `onClick` on a wrapping `Box`. Add `ChevronRightIcon` at top-right.
- **Remaining 4 cards** (Delivery Rules, Widget Customisation, Customer Waitlist, Settings): Change grid from `xs:1, sm:2, md:3` → `xs:1, sm:2, md:2`. Remove `Button` from inside each card. Make each card clickable via `onClick` on a wrapping `Box` with `style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}`. Add `ChevronRightIcon` at top-right of each card header using `InlineStack align="space-between"`.
- **Customer Waitlist card**: Add stat: `{stats.waitlist} waiting` in subdued text if waitlist > 0.
- **Delivery Rules card**: Add stat: `{stats.deliveryRules} rules` in subdued text.
- **Rename "Settings & Billing"** → **"Settings"**.
- Remove the section that currently wraps all 5 cards in one grid — split into: (a) full-width ZIP codes card, (b) 2x2 grid of the other 4.

### 8. Empty state
- When `isEmpty === true`: hide the stats card, hide the usage bar, hide the upgrade banner
- This is already partially handled by the new section order conditions. Make sure stats card condition is `!isEmpty`.

---

## Important rules:
- Use ONLY Polaris v13 components — no raw HTML for layout
- Import `Tooltip` and `ChevronRightIcon` from their respective Polaris packages if not already imported
- After making all changes run `npm run typecheck` and fix every TypeScript error before finishing
- The file is at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app._index.tsx`
- Match all existing patterns — look at how other components are imported and used in the file
